resolutions.researcher_notes: current_ref (Instagram) was DEAD_LINK (JS-rendered, content not independently confirmable). Tried web.archive.org for the original utg.uz Feb-2023 press release first (per instructions) but it has no snapshot and the live URL 301-redirects (utg.uz's press archive has been restructured site-wide, confirmed by curl -sI). Fell back to two other Russian-language sources, already vetted in the deep-sweep audit shard, that independently confirm construction is ongoing (not completed) as of their publication dates: (1) gazeta.uz, 2023-09-30 ('www.gazeta.uz/ru/2023/09/30/uztransgaz/'): reports continued 'строительство новой нитки протяжённостью 95 км по направлению Янгиер-Ахангаран' (construction of a new 95 km line toward Yangiyer-Akhangaran) -- Uztransgaz-attributed, verified OK/200 with 'Янгиер' + 'строительств' both present in visible text. (2) Enter Engineering Pte.Ltd.'s official Telegram channel (t.me/enterengineeringpteltd/4500), undated in the rendered view but necessarily later (references a modernization project 'entering its decisive phase'): og:description reads 'В Ташкентской области в решающую фазу вступил проект по модернизации газотранспортной системы АО «Узтрансгаз»... В данное время осуществляются работы на участке Янгиер — Ахангаран, в которых задействованы 270 человек и 100 единиц техники' (In Tashkent region, a project to modernize JSC Uztransgaz's gas transport system has entered its decisive phase... works are currently underway on the Yangiyer-Akhangaran section, involving 270 workers and 100 pieces of equipment) -- present-tense 'currently underway,' i.e. still construction, not completed. Two distinct organizational origins (state gas company Uztransgaz via gazeta.uz vs. private EPC contractor Enter Engineering via its own channel), consistent with the independence reasoning already used for this row's Operator finding, so tier=high. No source anywhere (Russian or English) claims commissioning/completion of this line -- 'construction' is the correct, actively-supported value, not stale.
